insights: Wrist spinners are the market's best value: they sell for 17% below fair value (median, n=17), while anchors sell for 2.5x fair value (n=24).
Powerplay specialists sell for 18% below fair value, vs death specialists who sell for 1.3x fair value (n=96 / 102).
Output is only part of the price: +1 run/match of impact adds 24% to price, but an international cap adds 157%; impact and profile explain just 30% of price variation.

price_model.formula: log_price ~ impact + overseas + capped + has_prev + log_prev + C(season_cat)
